styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating deep teal #17786C seamless panels for hero/spec/CTA screens and clean white #FFFFFF infographic panels; scene shots stay in muted grey-teal environments #5B6B68
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright cool studio key from the front-left with soft fill, controlled soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars on the shell
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white round pedestal #FFFFFF and matte light-grey board #F4F5F4
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only, #FFFFFF on deep teal panels and #2D2D2D on white panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular icons in a single accent color #4FA693
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and product scale across the set; product never clipped by frame; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent power-sport energy ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep teal #17786C, pure white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2D2D2D and soft mint-teal accent #4FA693; bright cool studio lighting with soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line circular icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 9 张电动车锂电池爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌标贴、店招二维码、原文案，具体容量/电压等数值与安全参数均以槽位承接、生成时填入，产品一律以 {product} 承接，警示标签与认证标不复刻；信任镜以保护机制图标与外壳工艺等可验证细节呈现，不写入任何资质/检测承诺。
